title: Bounded finite-module complex models from etale-local cohomology
statement: Let X be locally Noetherian and quasi-compact, B finite commutative, R a ring sheaf identified with constant(B) by phi, K any derived R-module object and V an etale chart. If the restrictions of H^q(K) to V vanish outside [a,b] with a<=b and each H^q(K) has finite constant B-module models on etale coverings of charts over V, then a covering sieve T of V gives, on every nonempty W->V in T, an actual finite B-module complex P in [a,b] and the specified isomorphism between the restriction of K and the restriction of its scalar-changed constant realization. No adic datum, residue model, projectivity or Tor hypothesis occurs. Constant realizations and scalar change use [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-quotient-model-data], and restriction uses [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction]. The constant realization functor is assumed to preserve zero morphisms.

proof.text: Descend the object to L on the etale site of V.left, retaining bounds, finite cohomology local models and transport of any subsequently supplied model.
Apply etale_site_bounded_constant_models with exactly [a,b] to get a jointly surjective etale covering and bounded finite algebraic complexes E over ULift(B).

Restrict the coefficient action along ULift(B) ≃ B. Finite generation makes each term small. Replace each term by its Shrink carrier and conjugate all differentials by the linear equivalences; conjugation proves the complex equations and gives a chain isomorphism from the lifted small complex to E. Transport both strict degree bounds and finite generation.

Form the sieve generated by the etale covering charts composed with V->X. Joint surjectivity proves it covers. On an arbitrary arrow in this sieve, factor through a chart, pull back the model isomorphism, use upperStarComp and upperStarConstantSheafIso, then apply the origin transport clause. Reuse the same small algebraic complex and bounds.

theorem finiteCoefficient_etale_bounded_models
    (X : Scheme.{t}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    (B : Type t) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    [(koszulConstantFunctor X B).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{t + 1})
    (φ : adicConstantRing X B ⟶ R) (hφ : IsIso φ)
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{t + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R))) (V : X.Etale)
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hvan : let R₀ := ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R);
      ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero
        ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj V)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K)))
    (hloc : let R₀ := ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R);
      ∀ (q : ℤ) (W : X.Etale) (_g : W ⟶ V),
        ∃ S : Sieve W, S ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology W ∧
          ∀ (Z : X.Etale) (f : Z ⟶ W), S f →
            ∃ N : ModuleCat.{t} B, Module.Finite B N ∧ Nonempty
              ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
                  ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K) ≅
                (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
                  ((completedAdicChange X φ).obj
                    ((ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{t + 1, t} B ⋙
                  ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{t + 1}
                    (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{t + 1} B ≃+* B).toRingHom ⋙
                  koszulConstantFunctor X B).obj N)))) :
    ∃ T : Sieve V, T ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology V ∧
      ∀ (W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ V), T g → Nonempty W.left →
        ∃ P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} B) ℤ,
          P.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
          (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite B (P.X i)) ∧ Nonempty
            (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses
                ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R)
                ((toProEt X).obj W) K ≅
              ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses
                ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R)
                ((toProEt X).obj W) ((completedAdicDerivedChange X φ).obj
                  (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (finiteModelConstantComplex X B P))))
